summary: Iter22 P2 Kinerja Pengrajin Dashboard — Backend: 6/6 pytest cases PASS (guest 403, default month, response shape, sort+rank, on-time scenario with seeded pipeline PO→SPK→BarangMasuk→grinda/servis/finishing/packing yielding qty_selesai=10, on_time_rate=100%, badge=MVP, and badge logic). Frontend UI verified via Playwright: kinerja-pengrajin-card visible for admin with month picker and 6 ranked rows (testids kinerja-row-1..N, kinerja-rank-1, kinerja-badge-1). Card NOT visible for guest role. Overall PASS.

minor.issue: on_time_rate is null (not 0) when total_spk_month==0. Frontend accepts null via `k.on_time_rate ?? 0` — works, but spec examples imply 0 default. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 2188 badge threshold uses `max(3, total//2)` — when total<=6, Produktif tier collapses to just rank 4-5, since max(3, 3)=3 means idx<3 is MVP and idx<3 for Produktif is empty. Formula only meaningfully separates tiers when total>=7. Consider `idx < 3 + max(1, total//2 - 3)` or clearer intent.

Nested async loop: for each SPK item, a separate db.po.find_one and db.progres.find is executed (O(N*M)). For a large month with many SPKs this becomes expensive. Consider aggregating packing sums into a dict up front keyed by (po_id, item_id, pengrajin_id, tanggal<=deadline).
seed_data_creation: Test creates and cleans up TEST_ITER22_* pengrajin/barang/PO/SPK/BarangMasuk with random uuid suffix; DB cleanup script also run post-test to remove any stragglers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter22 feature fully validated. Backend endpoint /api/dashboard/kinerja-pengrajin?month=YYYY-MM confirmed working with proper 403 on guest, default month, sort/rank, on-time computation, and badge assignment. Frontend Dashboard renders card + month picker + ranked rows with testids kinerja-pengrajin-card, kinerja-month-picker, kinerja-row-{rank}, kinerja-rank-{rank}, kinerja-badge-{rank}. Card is hidden for guest. Note: seeding a passing on-time scenario requires full pipeline (BarangMasuk before progres stages), because progres endpoint enforces sequential stage capacity.
